points: Annual reminder not to offer gifts or advantages to BD officers (same as 2025).
每年提示不得向屋宇署人員送禮（與 2025 年相同）。

CL_TCEAQTCPASCRBO2024.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Courses giving **academic qualifications equivalent** to those for **TCP T1–T3** under the Technical Memorandum for Supervision Plans 2009: HKIC/IVE **TCP T1 Training Course**; IVE **Professional Diploma in Construction Site Supervision**; IVE **Professional Diploma in Construction Engineering**.
可取得與《監工計劃書技術備忘錄》**T1 至 T3 技術人員**同等學歷的課程：建造業議會／IVE **T1 培訓課程**、IVE **建造地盤監督專業文憑**、IVE **建造工程專業文憑**。

The Professional Diploma in Construction Engineering is also accepted for an **Authorized Signatory** of an RGBC or an RSC (demolition, foundation, GI field works, site formation) under **PNRC 38**. Group enrolment via HKIC 2100 9892, IVE 2436 8790.
建造工程專業文憑亦獲接納為一般建築承建商或專門承建商（拆卸、地基、土地勘測、地盤平整）**獲授權簽署人**的學歷（PNRC 38）。

CL_FSMSW2024.status_note: Incorporated into APP-18, ADM-19, PNRC 52 and Form BA8A 已納入 APP-18、ADM-19、PNRC 52 及 BA8A 表格
points: **Two-stage pile foundation plan submission**: an RSE may split a pile foundation submission into two stages; required information in **APP-18 Annex C1**.
**樁基圖則分兩階段呈交**：註冊結構工程師可分兩階段呈交，所需資料見 **APP-18 附件 C1**。

**Concurrent approval and consent** for **secondary structural elements** (extended from the 27 Feb 2023 letter): curtain wall, window wall, cladding, space frame, precast element, canopy, skylight, balustrade, external ceiling, grille/louvre, ventilation duct, maintenance platform and similar – submit revised **Form BA8A** with the plans (ADM-19 revised).
**次要結構構件同時批准及同意**範圍擴大：幕牆、窗牆、覆面、空間框架、預製件、簷篷、天窗、欄杆、外部天花、格柵、通風管、維修平台等，隨圖則提交新 **BA8A 表格**。

**One Form BA16** for modification of **B(A)R reg 33(1)** covering all minor amendments of superstructure works (including secondary elements) after first approval and consent, if ADM-19 App. G criteria are met.
符合 ADM-19 附錄 G 時，只需提交**一份 BA16** 申請修改 B(A)R 第 33(1) 條，涵蓋上蓋所有輕微修訂。

**ESH Stage 3** (30 Jun 2024) accepts **all plan submissions**, including GBP and A&A, for 35 CPS departments. Benefits: concurrent electronic circulation and tracking; **BIM Area Tool** (Mar 2024) for GFA checks; paper savings (no ~10 copies of GBP). Aim: **mandatory e-submission in 2027**. See **ADM-17** and PNRC 42; hotline 3580 1000.
**電子資料呈交平台第三階段**（2024 年 6 月 30 日）接受**所有圖則**，包括一般建築圖則及加建改建；35 個中央處理部門同步電子傳閱；**BIM 面積工具**；目標 **2027 年強制電子呈交**。見 ADM-17 及 PNRC 42。

Result letters for **structural works** approval and consent applications (ELS, GI in scheduled areas, foundations and all structural works, excluding A&A and railway consultations) on **paper submissions** go electronic; **no hard copy after 2 Jul 2024**.

Phase 1 (from **2 Jul 2024**): sent by **e-mail** to the AP/RSE/RGE; Phase 2 (from **2 Oct 2024**): issued through **ESH**. Only the first page is attached to returned plans. Give an active e-mail in the covering letter and **activate ESH accounts**.
第一階段（2024 年 7 月 2 日起）以**電郵**發出；第二階段（2024 年 10 月 2 日起）經 **ESH** 發出；退回圖則只附第一頁。請提供有效電郵並**啟用 ESH 帳戶**。

CL_QSBWIMPTCASSSS2024.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_QSBWIMPTCASSSS2024.status_note: Extended to all works types from 1 Jul 2025 by the 31 Mar 2025 letter 已由 2025 年 3 月 31 日通告擴大至所有工程類別
points: Mandatory **Smart Site Safety System (4S)** measures: **Mobile Plant Alert System** (360° sensors; danger zone set by the Safety Officer, **≥ 2 m** from the plant) and **Tower Crane Alert System** (all loading zones at all levels; danger zone **≥ 7 m radius** from the hook; clearance **≥ 3 m**).
強制**智慧工地安全系統**：**流動機械警報系統**（360° 感應，危險範圍 **≥ 2 米**）及**塔式起重機警報系統**（危險範圍以吊鈎計 **≥ 7 米半徑**，淨空 **≥ 3 米**）。

From **1 July 2024**, **s 17(1) item 6** conditions on the **first approval or major revision of superstructure plans** when building works cost **> $30 million**; on consent, the AP must **declare** whether the cost exceeds $30 million (B(A)R reg 10) – no declaration may lead to refusal under **s 16(3)(b)**. AP/RSE/RGE still oversee the RC stream (Site Supervision Code Tables 4.1–4.3).
由 **2024 年 7 月 1 日**起，造價 **> 3,000 萬元**項目於**首次批准上蓋圖則**時附加條件；申請同意時認可人士須**聲明**造價，否則可按第 16(3)(b) 條拒絕。

CL_MWCSNCCCMW2024.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Many minor works **notices of commencement** and **certificates of completion** still late (after the 4 Jun 2015 letter). With immediate effect, **late submissions are returned** before acknowledgement.
小型工程**展開通知**及**完工證明書**仍多遲交；即時起，**遲交者退回**、不予確認。
Prosecution under **B(MW)R s 58** – fine up to **$50,000**; PBPs and PRCs also face disciplinary proceedings (suspension, removal, fine or reprimand).
可按《建築物（小型工程）規例》第 58 條檢控，最高罰款 **5 萬元**；訂明人士及承建商亦可被紀律處分。
